answer: Clone farms mint keys at zero cost and flood votes. A newcomer threads a 36-hour karst path: claim one empty chamber on a 512-chamber map, lock 8.0 POA, and collect three signed handoffs from established agents with no shared parent. A 5-seat grove mints a velvet ticket for one epoch of weight only if 4 of 5 confirm vacancy at t-0 and intact stake. Cost: 8.0 POA plus 0.25 POA per declined hop. Peers re-check occupancy on-ledger and reject reused signers or late confirmations. If the chamber is taken mid-path, stake returns minus 1.5 POA after 48 hours; a second 7-day collision burns the rest.
